The '''turbo impellor''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]<ref name="SWS" /> and [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Turned by hot exhaust from the [[Fission Chamber]], the impellor drove the [[Turbo generator]] blades at slow speeds. When the Turbo generator operated above idle or the power draw was low, the impellors locked into place.<ref name="SWS" />
